reviews.title: Tebbilbe airline and horrid airport staff
reviews.text: I had Airbaltic flight ticket from Hurghada to Riga. I arrived at the airport 3 hours before the plane's departure, by Uber taxi whose receipt confirms the arrival time. I had all my travel documents (EU passport, plane tickets) in order. I hadn't overstayed my visa either. The travel agency had even confirmed the flight by email a day earlier. The Air Baltic check-in staff did not allow check-in and did not issue a boarding pass. I visited Passport and Immigration office to ask advice. According to the head of this office, nothing prevents flying if I have a boarding pass. I went back to the Air Baltic check-in again. I asked the Air Baltic check-in staff to visit the this authority which was 90 meters away (Airbaltic staff refused). The Airbaltic check-in staff required me to buy a new flight ticket for another airline and asked to get out from terminal. I took a video recording of the whole situation where Air Baltic check-in staff prevent the check-in and did not give the boarding pass. I complained about the Airbaltics check in staff breaching of the contract, infringement of EU regulations and rudeness to Air Baltic's head office. Airbaltic did not agree to reimburse the cost of the return ticket of 700 euros. It is better avoid this airline.
reviews.author: lauratmm

reviews.title: AirBaltic - best at not delivering your baggage
reviews.text: Long before every airline stopped any free food and beverage service AirBaltic did that, for the ticket price of normal aricompany. Now they upgraded their service to delaying flight and baggage. I am lucky to have my baggage delayed two times in a row. And since Vilnius isn't my final destination (I have to take a bus from Vilnius to another country) I have to find a solution to their incompetence by myself. And they don't care if I lose time and money, talking to their customer service about reimbursement is waste of time in the end. Any connecting flight to Vilnius operated by AirBaltic is a lottery of arriving with or without suitcases. And normally connecting flights to Vilnius were delayed. (in baggage claim area there's Lost & Found counter. You can see how stuck with people and suitcases it is with almost every flight).
reviews.author: Bana N

reviews.title: Fresh and clean
reviews.text: Great fresh and friendly airline. Happily fly with them again. Definitely, something to recommend and look forward to if you book a flight with them or fly on one of their services for other airlines.
reviews.author: Alexander

reviews.title: Delays
reviews.text: Flight postponed by 2 hours 45 minutes. Very smart. No insurance claims. Not the nice way to treat customers. Very disappointed.
reviews.author: JK

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Feeling scamed, they to ofthen change "partner airline" and you are stuck with cheap airline and old plane with small uncomortable seat with no leg room.... Whats really the point paying extra if u get stuck flying cheap "rynair type airline" but paying 3x more for the flight, but no worries they give u some cheap 10 euro cupon for next flight, it hapened to me last 3 flights... And asking my friends its hapend with them allso. It was allso shown in latvian news, (airbaltic is Latvain airline) so i guess its comon pratice...
reviews.author: Matiss

reviews.title: Refuses to take responsibility for missing luggage
reviews.text: AirBaltic lost my luggage when I transferred to a flight out of Barcelona. Because I had an AirTag in my bag, I was able to share very precise location information with AirBaltic, information that they completely ignored. My bag was not returned to me until after I arrived home, 19 days in all. I had to purchase underclothes, pants, shirts, a sweater, socks, and a jacket -- nothing extravagant as I shopped at H&M and other discount stores. And yet, AirBaltic will only reimburse me for 40 euro because they made "a good faith effort" to find my bag. This claim is clearly false as they ignored every one of my attempts to share the bag's location with them. AirBaltic will not take responsibility for their failure. My itinerary was booked through United. I will be contacting United to urge them to avoid AirBaltic whenever possible. United risks its own reputation by associating with this airline.
reviews.author: DadaCabaret

reviews.title: Unfriendly staff
reviews.text: I booked the flight with SWISS but unfortunately it was operated by AirBaltic. After check of the ticket the lady asked us to wait without explaining the reason. Then she requested ticket again and put a badge on a luggage’s said to go further. When I asked to explain what is happening she denied to do so. Then I asked we have to pay and if that is taken into the baggage drop. She then confirmed. I strictly disagreed. For explaining the reason behind she claimed it is not allowed to have a luggage and a backpack (a female small backpack with only my passport and a charger inside) together which is not true. On top of that we were two people - with one luggage, one small female backpack and my husband had a normal backpack. Obviously, we were not above allowed 8kg per person plus a personal item each. When I tried to contradict and explained that I cannot wait for the luggage additionally at the arrival airport since I need to catch my train she was super rude and started to insist it was too heavy, not allowed, whatever. In the end, she started to fake that she’s calling someone and threatened me that „if you stay here you will not fly anywhere“. After understanding that I not taking her fake call seriously she let me take my luggage onto the plane. Ridiculous. I don’t suggest AirBaltic. This could be handled much nicer. Just zero service and rude!
reviews.author: Ekaterina N

reviews.title: Dissaponting and unreliable
reviews.text: Airbaltic has become an absolutely unreliable airline. Every single time we booked with this airline in recent months flights have been severely delayed. Although claming to be a hub for flights in the Baltics states the airline does not ensure reliable service for transit flights. Often early evening flights from Riga to Vilnius are pushed to very late hours at night, flights being delayed by 3-4 hours making travel with this airline very tyring. Also, you never know what kind of aircraft you will end up in as this airline is leasing fleet services of a number of little known charter companies. Disappointing.
reviews.author: RingaileS

reviews.title: Flight delays
reviews.text: My flight got delayed for 3 hours. They let us know very last minute. The same day a lot of other flights were delayed or canceled. They should’ve offer meal compensation, but they only gave 5 euro voucher which is enough to buy water
reviews.author: Katamaran88

reviews.title: Worst company to flight with ever
reviews.text: Ordered cappucino and cabin crew Alicia which put it for me didn’t explained that there is sugar inside already, not a big deal, just asked to chang it, as i taste it they cant changed, they can’t refund money, they can’t make a new one.. Cabin crew Alicia was very rude and tried to show me the line till she put this cappuccino, that i drunk a lot and they cant refund, but they can put more hot water to make the taste more disgusting Emirates please make sure that u collaborate with company with which can be proud about their service, quality the worst
reviews.author: Valeria O

reviews.title: Nickle and Dimed at Air Baltic
reviews.text: I have not even flown yet and am already being Nickle and dimed by Air Baltic. I booked my flight on KLM on the higher FLEX fare which included seat assignments. Now Air Baltic claims I will have to pay 69 Euro extra to get a seat assignment. Totally outrageous. I wish I had another option to fly but they have the monopoly for this flight it seems.
reviews.author: varvararodriques

reviews.title: For a low-cost airline, I would always choose AirBaltic
reviews.text: I have traveled with Airbaltic multiple times to Spain and England. This includes mostly direct flights but also a trip with one stop. Every time the experience has been very good, every flight has been on time on late by 15-20 minutes, but in this case, we have still arrived at the correct time. The staff has always been very helpful and friendly. They have never weighed my hand luggage or given any stress about luggage in the airports (that many low-cost airlines do). Also, even with the cheapest ticket you can still change your flight for only 50€ per person + a small fee if the new ticket is a bit more expensive. Also in this case they reply pretty fast. If you purchase some food on the flight or before, it tastes pretty good for airplane food. Obviously, it's still a low-cost airline but the price increase compared to Ryanair, WizzAir, or any other is completely justified.
reviews.author: Helen K

reviews.title: Well it is Baltic
reviews.text: Quality is average and I'm not quite sure in what category they believe them to be one of the best. Flights delayed and unclear communication. Please improve
reviews.author: Rasmus T

reviews.title: Delay
reviews.text: The flight was delayed and I was late to my next flight. Thank you very much, it costed me 5000k to buy new tickets! The worst experience ever.
reviews.author: rita l

reviews.title: How to screw your customers...
reviews.text: Was forced to have handluggage transported in the cargo hold, as it slightly exceeded the weight limit (a ridiculous limit of 8 kg). Cost: € 150. Given the very short connection time during stopover in Riga, I feared trouble. Stewardess at check-in bluntly told me that in such (likely) case, the luggage would indeed stay behind in Riga. And 20 or so other passengers were facing the same situation, so what is my problem ??? What kind of answer is that? Flew Air Baltic about 15 times, and this was the last. Many delays (3 hours or more, without any sort of compensation), rude personnel, poor communication. You name it, they provide it. Air Baltic, you are crap.
reviews.author: Ray A

reviews.title: Soat experience
reviews.text: Delayed departure, unfrendly, unorganized, confused staff. The back flight to Prague the same experience.
reviews.author: Michal K

reviews.title: Very expensive and very unfriendly staff
reviews.text: I have flown many times with air Baltic as it is the only one that has direct flight from Málaga to Tallinn. The staff at Tallinn airport is always very unfriendly and they are always looking to overcharge you for every gramm in your suitcase!!! If you fly from Málaga to Tallinn they are never very strick with overluggage and the stuff is always very friendly. Same airline but different staff. I am used to fly for over 200€ now the flights are over 500€!!! Most ridiculous prices. Today I received an email saying that they have sale and decided to have a look and comparing to few days ago (it was about 450€) now it is 500€. So do not believe when you see the SALE word it is all the opposite. The only good thing about air baltic is the selection and quality of food. I think they do not care about they reputation which is very bad and was like that for many years now.
reviews.author: _tiinagodfrey

reviews.title: Worst legroom I’ve ever experienced.
reviews.text: Had a short flight under two hours that was the most miserable flight of recent memory. Honestly the legroom is worse than Ryanair or Easyjet, which I know is quite surprising. At 189cm my knees were locked into position from start to finish and only half my bag would fit under the seat in front. Truly, have never experienced this, and at my height i’m pretty aware of how little space I usually get. Unless the price was rock bottom or you don’t mind a fair bit of claustrophobia, avoid Baltic at all costs.
reviews.author: Dan L

reviews.title: Cancelled flight, blameshifting
reviews.text: The flight was cancelled. The customer support, after waiting for an hour in line, was blameshifting and not accepting any responsibility, denying my customer rights. Avoid at all cost!
reviews.author: Vasilis Kalaitzis

reviews.title: Useless Executive level
reviews.text: Absurd, probably created when thinking customer last. You dont even see actual benefit listing in the app. App does not allow to manage your flight. Collected points not integrated as alternative payment method. You have to apply for ticket, wait for an email. Nightmare when you want combine 1 regular ticket with purchased one. They cannot merge into 1reservation. So you are split while seated, then have to purchase seat allocation. You can miss your main ticket while you wait for reward ticket.
reviews.author: Julius

reviews.title: Was punctual ...Now one of worst
reviews.text: If you booked transfer and want to fly with one of worst company Airbaltic, so you could say "bye,bye" for money paid for transfer. Flights always delay, our flight to and from Tenerife was delayed for 2 hours. I had to pay extra money for taxi, because our driver can't wait us so long at airport. "Airbaltic" always late...Be far away from this company and you will be lucky
reviews.author: Andrius G

reviews.title: The worst airline in Europe!
reviews.text: Air Baltics is an absolute nonsense of an airline, every single flight we had on our trip with them (which was 4 in total) were delayed, with the last one being delayed for 3 hours! For that these bastards gave an insulting 5 euro voucher, when the god damn sandwich cost 6.50! Literally the worst company I’ve ever flew with. Avoid them at all costs!
reviews.author: AverageTraveler69

reviews.title: DONT WASTE YOUR TIME
reviews.text: Always late, always problems. If you go for businesses , having a meeting, or have connected flights- it’s the worst airlines. Can’t plan, can’t count on them.
reviews.author: Elina A

reviews.title: Gift voucher
reviews.text: Never EVER accept a gift voucher as a refund for a cancelled flight from Air Baltic. I got a gift voucher because of a cancelled flight during the pandemic that had a duration of one year. Obviously I couldn’t fly between 2020-2022 so I called customer service and asked for them to move the expiration date. It was possible once but in the end I had to book a flight in November 2022 that I really couldn’t go to. I then paid extra to move the flight to april 2023. Well, unfortunately I got into accident and had to cancel my trip. I got back 60€ as a GiFT VOUCHER with a one year expiration date again. I will have several surgeries and will not be able to fly for one year but that is nothing they care about. What the hell am I going to to with a 60€ gift voucher…. Thanks alot. NOT. Never booking with Air Baltic.
reviews.author: ::123edw

reviews.title: Europs worst airline
reviews.text: Flight Tallinn Dubai Departure time on second leg Riga Tallinn changed 3 times. One day before departure flight Tallinn Riga cancelled so I had to call and rebook to an earlier flight. Stay over instead of one hour now 8 hours. Flight back from Dubai to Riga delayed by 2 hours and flight from Riga to Tallinn delayed by 3 hours. Mind you all of this is ONE trip. All that without as much as a free drink for 2 Euros offered. A free upgrade not to dream of. All I got was the computer generated"we apologize" which they must be sending out by the hundreds every day. As a frequent flyer I can say "easily the worst airline in Europe"
reviews.author: James123we

reviews.title: eastern-europe aircompany
reviews.text: Every flight delayed, refuse to pay regulated by EU law compensations, after 4h of deley they will give you 5€ voucher while cost of sandwich in that airport starts from 6.50€
reviews.author: Andrei M

reviews.title: The worst airline
reviews.text: I’ve been on the flight from CDG to VNO which was meant to leave at 18:15. During the day I’ve received a text saying that flight will be slightly delayed by a half an hour. It has now been two hours after scheduled departure time. The captain has just announced that there will be further delay for about 45min. During this time we were not offered any beverages or anything
reviews.author: Jonas Cernevicius

reviews.title: Dr.
reviews.text: Horrible experience - poor service and extremely unfriendly staff - in the airport of Tallinn and aboard the aircraft! Air Baltic - to be avoided by all means!
reviews.author: Victor B

reviews.title: Horrible flight experience
reviews.text: That was one of the worse aircrafts experiences I have ever experienced, and I have been flying around the word a lot! From the firs step in the aircraft it smelled liked toilet. Flight team didn’t clean the toilets not even once and they were already dirty when customers got on the plane. After 5h the smell was so bad that I had hard time breathing and we were sitting in row 15. On top of that I have never seen this ignorant flight team! It felt like they are literally blind. In order to pass them while they were selling coffee, travellers had to either stand and wait for hours or knock on their sholders to make themselves visible and pass the crew. Cherry on top, we had to call the team to get our trash collected (they didn’t do a single trash collecting round), twice, because at first time they told that they will be back in 1 minute to collect the trash (Which they obviously didn’t do). This was the last time we will ever fly long distance with airbaltic!
reviews.author: Karoliina P

reviews.title: interesting first A220 aircraft user airline
reviews.text: Very interesting airline. Service on board of this airline Airbus A220 aircraft was very nice, kind staff and no meals and water without additional pay during this flight. Some two dislikes arrive. At first, no water withhout additional pay. Food and other drinks I can understand, but water is needed. At second, no electricity contact nests to put charger and other electrical device to use. I think, it is not complicated in our 21st technology age put some at least 10 electricity contact nests for passangers to charge they device. Other Ok, Liked everything. https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/ShowUserReviews-g1-d8729054-r882546028-Condor-World.html#
reviews.author: Raimonds R

reviews.title: Forcing EVERYONE to check in hand luggage
reviews.text: Forcing all people to check in their hand luggage for no reason, all the drawers in the airplane ended up being empty because everyone had to give up their luggage. Instead they could have asked only the actually required amount of people to do so. Wasting people's time at the airport in an unfriendly manner when already taking off an hour late is not appreciated.
reviews.author: Rebecca

reviews.title: Problem creator very rude help dest at the Riga airport
reviews.text: Dear AirBaltic, “Unfortunately” I would like to share the “terrible” experience which I had together with my family with one of your staff who is supposed to be a kind of “representative of yours! “ Today around 11.00 in the morning at the Riga Airport we came to the Air Baltic service center desk. The reason for our visit was to ask about the payment email from AirBaltic for the added suitcase for my son's flight to Billund which I never received the night before even if I had a “your request has been received email”. And my wife (she is Latvian) has been asking nicely why we haven’t been receiving the payment email, obviously, we wouldn’t be coming to the service desk if we had the link. And she asked the service desk staff if he could send it again. And the answer was "we sent it system says it is sent and that's all you can buy here or go and book online again", I said ok let me book online again and after I try I saw that it is not possible to purchase 12 hr before flight leaves, which is understandable and there was no problem on that, but while I am trying to book online the discussion between my wife and AirBaltic staff was still going on about not received link. After all, I told him I can not buy it and showed him the red warning, and I also told him that he should know that it is not possible to purchase the service, why did he offer to book online I also started to tell my negative opinion and thoughts about the AirBaltic policy as well as how "not client-oriented" they are which is true and probably will never change and thousands are thinking same but as AirBaltic is almost a monopoly in Baltics people are using. And I also added that they act as a "low-cost airline" which is not as you know. And I also mentioned this is not the way to deal with clients by making faces and tones of strange mimics jests and tunes! He should solve the problem not create another problem by telling us to go book online when we can not due to the departure time of the flight. Now we are coming to the most important part; I turned and asked him why he tell me to book online while he can issue here and faced with the answer " I told this WOMAN" Let me inform you, not your client service desk staff, not your damn CEO can call my wife as "WOMAN" and I believe none of the ladies should call as "this woman"! If you do not have people on the front line who can talk and use English better at an international airline company, pay more and put in someone who can. And I corrected him that he can't call my wife WOMAN but a lady. And after that, I told him, please finalize the added suitcase, let me pay and go and he asked me If I wanted to buy it via him. I said yes of course. And such a surprise second part came and he told me while he was touching to keyboard and stopped turned me and he told me " I am not going to issue your suitcase until you apologize because I heard all that you told your wife about AirBaltic" Word by word this way, I am sure you record all conversations and they can listen. So I was told by AirBaltic staff that my private conversations are listened to by him, and I was asked to apologize because He did not like my comments that it was terrible service and policy and even more. And I said ok, first of all, you should not listen to my conversation because you have nothing to do to you and also you should apologize to my wife by calling her "THIS WOMAN ''. And after that, he called security, which I will deal with later by HAVAS why 11-12 members of staff have to come while there is no danger of anybody and some conversation going on about the bad behavior of incompetent Airline staff. I asked him to give me a document that he refused to sell me the luggage service, but he refused, I asked his name he also refused. And I also told him it is not a problem for me to purchase another ticket another day from another airline or AirBaltic and send him but I will deal with this issue. After all, we bought a suitcase at the check-in
reviews.author: Aydin B

reviews.title: Awful customer service & money lost
reviews.text: Just plain awful customer service and flight crew - rude. Words cannot even describe all of the misinformation that I was given at the airport and later by e-mail. Is it a national carrier or a low-cost airline? And as if this was not enough. I wasn't able to fly to my destination nor did not get any refund for the flights. Never was I given an alternative option to get to the destination or got any food coupons as it was going to be a long wait. I boycott this company for their below average attitude towards other humans! Learns some manners and grow a heart!
reviews.author: Dissapointed

reviews.title: Excellent A220
reviews.text: Excellent on-board experience, with huge legroom and space: stertching your legs with no problem is very uncommon (and pleasant, of course). Great airplane, good value for money carrier.
reviews.author: pebo2014

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: Worst airline. Their planes doesnt work. Have to wait several hours. If you want to fly wirh air baltic dont book your hotels for the same day because the flights are always late. Never again.
reviews.author: Elias P

reviews.title: The worst experience ever travelling in a plane.
reviews.text: What a horrible company to fly with in a long flight! The plane started one hour late (both ways) the space and comfort is definitely not enough for a 6 hour flight overseas. the flight “started” at 10:10 pm (we departed passed 11) the carts with the food where going until 2 am?? with the lights fully on of course. On top of that i tried to order some water and they told me I should purchase it but didn’t accept any debit payments, only credit (without any notice in the website or when u check in or boarding passes) my parter discussed a while with the stewardess how could we be flying for 6 hours without drinkable water and no possible way to get it. she kept repeating that is was unfair for everyone else to give us some. after 10 min discussion and 30 min wait she gave in and pour us a glass. this flight was specially horrible because so many people were watching devices with no headphones and really loud and half of the flight were infants crying non stop(i know that’s not the baby’s fault but just so you can get a picture of our time this night), plus all the food served there was really smelly (like curry style) and the farts of people after weren’t the best. (trying to be honest and helpful here hah) anyway first and last time flying with them. at least from australia I recommend jetstar better all the way. maybe not an incredible flight but the seats are more comfortable and they don’t deny you to drink water because is not in their “policy” to give free water. Plus being able to pay with australian debit card and more snacks than cooked fragant food.
reviews.author: Manuela O

reviews.title: good share code with SAS
reviews.text: it was a share code with SAS, and at the beginning I was a bit reluctant as I had never heard before of this airline. Clearly a budget airline, which lives up to the standards of basic economy. However, it was very efficient, staff were polite and tentative and cabin even though a bit tired was comfortable. I wouldnt fly them again as I am not sure how reliable they are overall, however this experience was just fine. It took me from point a to b, with no major issues
reviews.author: LacLeman

reviews.title: Violin Musical Instrument
reviews.text: Terrible Experience, Awful Behavior They didn't let me to take my Violin, which match the dimensions.
reviews.author: Ljupcho

reviews.title: Partial payment incomplete - booking cancelled without any refund or explanation
reviews.text: So Air Baltic apparently come up with the idea of offering partial payment or installment like many other merchants out there with big purchase. By right partial payment scheduled once every month should be charged to credit card automatically, but in the case of Air Baltic, you may need to manually clear the payment on your own. I missed the second payment deadline and on the next day, I received an email informing me that my booking has entirely been cancelled, and there will be no refund or rebooking or whatever so. My first payment was taken away for nothing, and they would not refund it for cancelling the entire booking, simply because I missed the second payment for a day. Who would expect to have to go into the payment page to do it manually? It's designed in a way to take your first payment without having to offer you any services. This is fraudulent and a disgrace to commercial aviation. I have since filed a chargeback on the first payment, pending investigation.
reviews.author: Kae G

reviews.title: Really poor customer service!!
reviews.text: Poor customer service! Really unhelpul customer care repeating over and over what they can not assist with rather then being helpful!
reviews.author: Krisztina L

reviews.title: Customer service was way better before
reviews.text: I always was using Airbaltic despite the prices are higher than others airlines. Until last situation that happened in my family. My child and me got Covid, I phoned a week in advance and mentioned that we have got temperature and day before we found out that we have got Covid. Of course, we couldn’t fly. Firstly, my son was felling very badly and secondly I would put in risk other passengers and my family. So, I wrote complaint that seems nobody was interested to deal with. I even didn’t ask for a refund, I was more than happy to receive a gift card and use it towards next trip. It’s a shame, that my complaint hasn’t been dealt and the situation hasn’t been resolved. Unfortunately, I have to choose different airline for my trips.
reviews.author: Ms T

reviews.title: Delayed and delayed
reviews.text: Our aircraft arrived from Riga to Madrid only 14 minutes delayed but departed 83 minutes late. According to the timetable, the turnaround time in Madrid is just 40 minutes. It is ridiculous because Madrid is a big airport and just taxiing from the runway to the gate and back to the runway takes at least 15-20 minutes. It was a snowstorm in Riga and all other flights were also delayed. So it was a long wait in Riga for our next flight to Helsinki. The storm was not big when it started but Riga Airport couldn't handle this amount of snow. So the departure of our connecting flight from Riga to Helsinki was delayed by 2'40 and we arrived in Helsinki just before three o'clock in the night. The service on the Madrid-Riga flight was a little bit strange. My partner had ordered a cold meal and got it 20 minutes before my warm meal was delivered. My meal was burning hot. It had been too long in the oven and the pork was dry. Maybe after this experience, we will stick to Finnair. Direct flights are less prone to delays. Or at least you don't have to stress if you are going to catch your next flight.
reviews.author: Mikael F

reviews.title: Pleasant flights from Helsinki to Madrid
reviews.text: We booked our flights in March. There was an affordable offer of 214 euros pp for a return Classic Economy ticket. This fare includes priority check-in, checked luggage, and seat reservations. Also, they could be changed and canceled for a fee. In July, Air Baltic changed the departure time from Helsinki from 10:10 to 8:40. Our transfer time in Riga was increased to 3'40. Also, our Monday return flight was canceled and we were changed to a Sunday flight. Air Baltic uses modern A220 planes with seating 2+3. It is ideal for couples if you reserve your seat beforehand. The only criticism is that there is only one toilet for economy class that can be more than 140 passengers. However, Air Baltic doesn't offer any complimentary drinks and that reduces the need for toilets. Our flights were both on time. The service was friendly. We had preordered meals for the Riga-Madrid flight. They were served quickly after takeoff but were lukewarm. However, quite tasty.
reviews.author: Mikael F

reviews.title: Outrageous surcharges for baby
reviews.text: We had purchased flights with the intention of adding an unborn baby to the ticket at a later stage, as guided by AirBaltic. While for other kind of changes Air Baltic typically charges 0-50€ according to their fare policies, for adding our baby (sitting on parent’s lap!) the airline applied a surcharge of 120€ on top of the ticket price. So be aware of this if you plan to fly with Air Baltic with your newborn - babies seem to be the company’s moneymakers! …basically our baby - without his own seat - had to pay nearly as much as the other passengers.
reviews.author: Juuli L

reviews.title: Terrible experience. Avoid AirBaltic !!!
reviews.text: We were denied boarding with two small kids and connecting flights. The airline didn't follow the processes. they didn't call for volunteers. the worse thing was there were plenty of seats available in the aircraft; however, the gate personnel so incompetent to change the aircraft type in the computer to match the actual aircraft. We were offered gift vouchers however airline did not provide other compensation (hotel, meal, alternative transport) according to Regulation (EC) no 261/2004.
reviews.author: Atlas

reviews.title: lovely experience
reviews.text: lovely experience travelling with this airline would surely recommend it! friendly crew, beautiful aircraft and nice buy-on board service!
reviews.author: Jorian G

reviews.text: Air Baltic is very good airline, I m reccomending to fly with Air Baltic. Check in was pretty good same as baggage claim. Seat was pretty good but tray table was little bit small overral seat was good. Overral I think Air Baltic has worth to fly with Air Baltic. 3h fligth was pretty good with this low cost airline also if you want pre-order your meal I reccomending to pre-order your meal on 1h+ plus flights.

reviews.title: 33 min flight
reviews.text: Air Baltic is very good airline about short flight and it is good airline to take short flight and 33 min flight you dont need to expet the catering service just enjoy your flight.

reviews.author: Rachel S

reviews.title: Extortion! Liars! AVOID at ALL COSTS!
reviews.text: I could write an entire book about this incredibly traumatic and awful experience with this thoroughly despicable airline, but I'll stick with the basics. They lie and they steal and then they will try to steal more. My pregnant wife and 9 year old from the USA were traveling in Europe and after making us pay huge baggage fees, even for carry-ons we had to check, Air Baltic held us up at the desk for almost two hours. We asked to speak with a supervisor the entire time and they never came. They finally let us through with only 15 minutes until the flight departed. When we got to the gate to load into our plane, the front desk agent came and told us to check our email and that we owed more money. There was an email bill for almost $2000 (in Euros) that they said we had to pay otherwise we could not get on the plane. They would not tell us what the $2000 was for and when we said we weren't going to pay it, they refused to let us on our flight and escorted back to baggage claim. We were stranded in Finland and had to purchase new tickets on FinnAir (who were very nice and charged us NOTHING for bags and didn't give us any issues at all). Ironically, the same person who held us up at the gate was the same person who tried to get the money from us and the same person who escorted to baggage claim and left us there. As he was leaving he told us he didn't even work for Air Baltic but his company was hired by them. This means we never actually spoke with an actual Air Baltic employee during the entire experience! We were told a supervisor would come speak with us 'in 5-10 minutes' but they never came. Since this incident, Air Baltic has refused to give us our money back from a flight we weren't allowed to get on. They also refused to give us our baggage fees back. They've been extremely rude and are crooks. When we've tried to comment and write on social media, they've blocked us. Avoid this airline at all costs! They may appear to be cheaper initially, but will rip you off at every opportunity and try to extort you. This is one seriously evil company. Spread the word!
reviews.author: JWH

reviews.title: Not to be repeated
reviews.text: I took a return from Gatwick to Riga. The 9.25am Gatwick flight was cancelled - nothing to do with Air Baltic - but Air Baltic communicate by e mail and I don't have a smart phone. So all the passengers were gathered and dumped outside the airport with no idea what was happening and no staff to ask. Eventually I explained the situation to the airport information point who told me I was rebooked onto the 17.25pm but no-one could give me access to a phone or e mails and I was directed to the Hilton Hotel where I did find a computer I could use. Only several hours later was I able to get a new boarding pass and when I asked a £5.00 food voucher - buys next to nothing - and get back through security to departures. I have since learned that Air Baltic have no staff at Gatwick but use an agent who obviously didn't care what happened to passengers. If things go wrong you are on your own. However, my flight back from Riga was trouble free.

reviews.title: Avoid this company

We wanted to cancel our fligts 1 month before trip so there was pretty good notice period. We contacted customer support to get our tickets money back but they refused to refund tickets. I filed compliance about the situation that this is not okay that we cant get any money back because of health reasons. Now after 2 months, nobody has written back. AIR BALTIC IS CUSTOMER HOSTILE COMPANY. They dont care about you, they only care about money!

reviews.title: AVOID!!! AVOID! AVOID!
reviews.text: I’m actually surprised that this company still operates and earns a lot of money! Our flight to Vilnius was cancelled due to the “ stormy weather” which we learnt about in hour after our arrival to Gatwick. Spent another 2 hours queuing to the customer service window to find out any information about our flight and a solution/replacement/rebooking etc. it was chaotic!!! No one knew anything! Eventually we were sent to Gates 18 to claim our bags and thats it. We were free to go anywhere but not to Vilnius, though. I got an email though stating that I can take the flight the next morning at 7am from Heathrow to Helsinki, then from Helsinki to Vilnius. That means I have to travel somehow from Gatwick to Heathrow, find a hotel/room for a night at my own expense and claw my money back ( if lucky!!!) from Air Baltic. I’ve already lost my booking at the hotel in Vilnius and the bus fare from Vilnius to Minsk because of the cancellation and I didn’t want to go with that option. So, I went for the direct flight 2 days later!!! Thank God, that rebooked flight was smooth and I’d give it solid 4 Stars but the flight back from Vilnius to London was another nightmare!!! I received an email stating that our flight was delayed for 2 hours bit we still have to head to the airport. At the check in desk we were given a “meal” voucher worth 6 Euro each which is a joke! You can’t even buy a slice of pizza and a cup of coffee for 6 euro!!! Then, this nightmare continues! Overall, we waited 4hours before we allowed to board the plane. Never again!!!!! I will never ever fly with Air Baltic again and you shouldn’t either! Avoid at all cost!!!

reviews.title: Awful airline experience and the worst customer service
reviews.text: I am an experienced flier who travelled a lot for work and pleasure. My trip with AirBaltic was one of the most stressful experiences and their customer service was just useless. My 3 year old and I almost missed out flight because there was not enough staff to check on bags. One person at the counter who appeared an hour before the flight was due to close. It completely puzzles me - airline knows how many bags will be checked in as most of them are pre-paid. How can they compromise customers by not staffing the counters appropriately. I called the airline - they did very little and said to call them back if we miss the flight. We had to leave you bag at the storage facility to make the flight, incurring additional expenses. After asking for a refund, it took for the airline 3 weeks to send a generic response. They took no responsibility and were highly dismissive. While charging a premium vs other airlines - AirBaltic provides no benefits for it and treats customers worse than budget airlines.

Air Baltic was more than happy to take my money for a service they knew at time of accepting the payment they could not provide. Some people might call that a scam. This was very annoying as I was assuming Air Baltic would operate as a regular airline - and I had had very good experience with my recent budget flight at Ryanair.

reviews.title: Took last money from Ukrainian war refugees who lost everything, declined boarding and refused to refund
reviews.text: I was helping a family of Ukrainian refugees as a volunteer to book flight Tallinn (TLL) - Berlin (BER) for 20.05.2022 but after payment they received tickets for 17.06.2022. To make sure they leave tomorrow, I paid for another set of tickets with my own card. Next day I learned that Airbaltic didn't let Ukrainian war refugees board the flight today due to lack of COVID vaccination certificate and they didn't even let them do an express COVID test. This poor family was refused to board the flight they paid their last money for. After being left with no home and little money, having spent more than 3 days moving non-stop through the aggressor's Russian territory, having paid for Airbaltic tickets twice the full price to get refuge in Europe and unite with their friends in Germany. This is inhumane. They had no more money left to book a room to stay overnight or transport to go further. The customer support was useless and unwilling to help to refund the money. The irregularity claim took them a month to respond to just to say that they can't refund the full price. Now they will take one more month to refund 6% (airport tax) of the full cost. While other companies offer free services to people who have lost everything due to war, Airbaltic takes their last money and refuses to provide the service. Incredibly disappointed in this company and their values.

reviews.author: Stas L

reviews.title: Average flight around Europe
reviews.text: airBaltic is an airline based in Riga, Latvia and is a low-cost hybrid carrier. They are low-cost in that they only operate one type of aircraft, Airbus A220, and they charge for extras like seat assignment and baggage. They are a hybrid because they offer business class and partner with many airlines and that can include complimentary luggage. They are also hybrid because tickets include one carry-on and one personal item. I had heard of airBaltic as they were the primary customer of the Airbus A220 which is a new plane model that is a 2-3 seat configuration. airBaltic operates mostly a regional network within Europe with additional flights to Central Asia and Dubai. I had 3 flights with airBaltic and they were all a bit different. Flight 1 was Tallinn to Stockholm, flight 2 was Stockholm to Riga, and flight 3 was Riga to Munich. All of these were booked differently so flight 1 was the complete low-cost experience as it was ticket only, no additional seats nor luggage was purchased. Flight 2 included checked baggage so it was termed as 'Economy plus' but the plus did not include seat reservation nor priority boarding as some other low-cost carriers include in this bundle, it only included 23kg of checked baggage. Flight 3 was in partnership with Lufthansa so I booked the ticket on Lufthansa and the first leg was operated by airBaltic. Although each flight was booked differently, the operating aircraft was the same on each flight, the check-in process was the same, and the on-board experience was the same for each flight. As I had mentioned, airBaltic is a low-cost hybrid airline. Your booked ticked includes a hand-carry and personal item, everything else needs to be purchased including checked baggage and seat assignments. There are categories that include checked baggage but that is all they include and no other amenities are included. It was very easy and efficient to book the travel through airbaltic's website and through the process you can add extras like seat assignment or checked baggage for a fee. After your booking and days leading up to your flight you will get messages from airbaltic asking if you want to prebook/purchase a seat or prebook/purchase a meal. You are able to check-into your flight 36-hours in advance (more if you have prebooked your seat) and during that process you can also preselect your seat. If you do not select a seat then you are assigned a random seat at check-in and there is no option on the site to change the seat (the only option is to ask at the airport at the check-in desk). For one flight I had personal item only while my other 2 flights I had checked baggage so for those I had to stop at the check-in desk. The service both on the ground and on-board was not great, not bad but not great. They would answer a question if you had one but not proactively offer assistance or notice that a guest needed assistance. For two of my flights, I was able to arrange a different seat assignment at the check-in desk and that was done with no hesitation. Boarding is supposed to happen 30 minutes prior to the flight but everyone of my flights were delayed. That would not be a big deal but in each instance the gate agents made no announcement nor was there any information provided; the only notice would be an email from airbaltic after the time had passed notifying you of the delay. This email was the only communication from either the ground staff, gate agents, or airline regarding any delays. When we were finally ready for boarding, it was everyone all at once; those who needed assistance came first and after that it was everyone on board with no boarding groups or other order. Each operating aircraft was exactly the same - an Airbus A220 with a 2-3 seat configuration. Both the outside and the inside looked relatively new and the planes looked in good shape. The seats were basic in that up top had a place for magazines, below was a tray table, and below that two small back pockets on each side of the tray

reviews.text: For some reason, airBaltic seems entirely unable to keep to their flight schedule. In the past 6 times I have flown with airBaltic, only 1 flight was on time. The rest always get delayed. If you think your flight is at 8pm, then think again: it is bound to be delayed at least 40 minutes. Perhaps calling the airline unreliable is a bit hars, considering you can rely on the fact that they will never be on time. Don't fly airBaltic if you have some place to be at a certain time because you will not make your appointments/catch your train or buss/make it on the day you're supposed to arrive on. Plus the 35€ check-in fee at the airport is quite ridiculous. They do inform you of it in the emails, but I have yet to find an explanation as to why it even exists. Where is the money going? What, exactly, am I paying for? It's clearly not for for a timely service, because that seems literally impossible for you. AirBaltic is like that one friend who is always late to every event and thinks its "cute" or "quirky". It's not - its simply disrespectful of everyone else's time. If you can, do try to choose another airline. ANY other airline. Or take a train - it is bound to get you to your destination faster than airBaltic.

reviews.title: Baltic Air - last minute change of flight - unaccepable.
reviews.text: Disgusted with such short notice with change of flight from Gatwick to Riga tomorrow. Now loosing a days holiday for a very short weekend in Riga- not to mention time there cut short and time difference. Flight at 09.25 and now changed to 17:20. 8 hours later. Just not acceptable. Short email from them with new flight information. Loosing a days annual leave by doing this. No apologies or reason from Baltic Air or offer of compensation. Will NEVER ever use this airline again after my first diabolical experience with them and haven't even got on the plane yet!! Shame on you Air Baltic. Should have taken not of all the bad reviews before I booked with you.

reviews.author: Lii R

reviews.title: Money scam
reviews.text: Don't be surprised if you are never able to get the price that is listed on their own website. AS I was finishing my booking and clicked "Pay" after entering my payment card details the page redirects you to the home page that there was an "error" and now the exact same tickets cost 25% more!! I am already paying for the tickets and they decide, that I should pay 25% for no good reason! What is the point of choosing a price it the tickets are not reserved or held at a price point while you are booking the tickets? Also duty-free bag is part of your luggage weight!! So if you decide to get something at the shop you can easily get a 60 eur fine for having your items over-weight.
reviews.author: Niklavs

reviews.title: Don't fly Airbaltic
reviews.text: I had booked to fly beginning of Feb, I had my Russia to VISA and everything all ready, I had booked Airbaltic with connection in Riga, Latvia. When I boarded in London everything was fine, my VISA to russia was all fine and checked. I waited in Riga for the next flight also with Airbaltic. However was not allowed on board as I was not allowed as a British citizen to fly to Russia from Latvia. I was treated with so much disrespect. It was the end of the day too and no one from the Airbaltic airline gave me information about or gave me information about the flights leaving Riga so I could back. I was stranded there as a female of colour solo traveller too. This was the worst experience and as someone who travels frequently. I had spend money on a hotel and then flights to Finland and then Russia (Through Finnair which I highly recommend). Airbaltic are scammers and have no respect for their customers. I haven't received any money back or even acknowledgement for mistakes on their part.
reviews.author: Imasha H

reviews.title: Too expensive for such a service
reviews.text: Purchased two trips Vilnius - amsterdam and return. Paid 480 eur return. Ticket type GREEN which would mean that for 50 eur and price difference (if here is such) I can change my flight. Due to some issues I could not flight to amsterdam and called customer service to change my ticket Vilnius - Amsterdam, after 2 calls and total 1 hour of discussion with them got no solution as they only offered me to change both tickets and pay extra 50 + 50 eur. I did not need to change return ticket, so they called the situation "rerouting" can't be done, I had to change both flights pay extra 100 eur. Thats rip off, still do not understood why did not I booked same flights with wizzair or ryanair monday to friday for up to 80 eur return and instead decide to buy expensive airbaltic 480 eur + possibly 100 eur extra. Airbaltic you wont go far with such a prices and service.

reviews.title: Good Airline
reviews.text: I fly with them frequently and have Exec status. They are good. They are almost always ontime. Decent legroom. Clean modern aircraft. Be warned they do occasionally weight bags at the gate and charge you if you are over weight but I think that's fair enough.
reviews.author: Andy G

reviews.title: Thank you Guys!
reviews.text: I want to thank the Air Baltic team for their responsiveness! Especially the passenger check-in agent Kristina, who helped us get to the boarding when we ran in at the last moment. We were incredibly lucky to get to check in with Kristina, she is a very kind, understanding and empathic person. Politely reassured us, called for boarding, agreed with colloquies to wait for us on boarding, helped with luggage. She did everything for us and we happily flew away. This lady knows her job and knows how to provide excellent service. Thanks, guys, for your competency and positive attitude!
